reason.description: One reason a capability check denied the request. The "kind" discriminates the shape: session capability kinds carry a human-readable "detail"; transaction-scoped kinds name the denied object (tenant, state, or resource).

reason-capability.description: A session capability check failed. "kind" identifies the unmet capability (or "identity" for an is-user check); "detail" is a human-readable explanation.

reason-resource.description: A modified resource in an allowed state matches none of that state's patterns. "fq_address" is the resource's fully-qualified address; "state_id" identifies the state it lives in (the same fq_address can appear in multiple states).

reason-state.description: A modified state is absent from the capability's states map. "state_id" identifies the state.

reason-subgraph.description: A node in the transaction's generated subgraph (a cone/blast dependency, not a directly-modified resource) matches none of the capability's subgraph patterns. "fq_address" is the node's fully-qualified address.

reason-tenant.description: The transaction's tenant is not permitted. "tenant_id" identifies the tenant.

response.description: Returned with HTTP 403 (or recorded as a failed transaction task's result) when the caller's capabilities do not authorize the request. "reasons" lists every unmet requirement; for an OR of requirements, all failing alternatives are listed. "truncated" is true when more reasons exist than are listed (transaction-scoped denials cap the list; session denials never truncate).
